label: Sho
note: Tibetan yoghurt, also churned for butter

about.text: Sho is the Tibetan word for the yoghurt made from the milk of the dri, the female yak. It is the usual first step of Tibetan butter-making and gives its name to the Shoton yoghurt festival.
